meta.source: Curated from prospectuses, intention-to-float announcements and pricing releases
meta.note: There is no EDGAR equivalent in Europe: filed ranges live in prospectuses and ITF releases, not in a machine-readable filing index. This panel is therefore assembled deal by deal. A monthly scheduled task appends newly priced European IPOs with a source link for each row; anything with verified=false has not yet been checked against a primary document and is excluded from the headline statistics.

schema.priced: ISO date the offer price was set
schema.range_low / range_high: the filed / ITF price range in the issue currency
schema.first_day_ret: per cent, offer price to first closing price
schema.stooq: optional Stooq symbol (e.g. 'vsure.st') if prices should be fetched automatically
schema.verified: true only when range and offer were read off a primary document linked in 'source'
